in_sanskrit.name: Ojal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Ojaswini, symbolizing strength and vitality
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ojal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ojas’, which means ‘vital energy’ or ‘strength’, Ojal is a feminine name inspired by the Goddess Ojaswini. This divine figure is revered for her power and vitality, often invoked to strengthen the body and mind. In Hindu mythology, Ojaswini is also associated with wisdom and prosperity.
